title: PhysEvolve: Verifier-grounded Self-evolution for Physical Reasoning with Executable Worlds
abstract: arXiv:2610.34921v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Physical reasoning underpins how embodied systems understand and act in the physical world, yet vision-language models (VLMs) remain unreliable on questions about dynamics and physical causality. Progress is critically constrained by the scarcity of grounded counterfactual training data, as observational videos capture only the factual trajectory that occurred. The self-evolving paradigm offers a route beyond fixed datasets by enabling models to construct their own training problems. Extending this paradigm to physics, however, requires an external source of truth that can both validate model-proposed environments and verify alternative physical outcomes under intervention. We introduce \physevolve{}, a verifier-grounded self-evolving framework that trains VLMs for causal physical reasoning from model-proposed executable worlds and simulation-authored tasks. translated_title: PhysEvolve：基于验证器的可执行世界物理推理自进化框架
translated_abstract: 物理推理是具身系统理解物理世界并采取行动的基础，然而视觉语言模型（VLM）在涉及动力学和物理因果性的问题上仍然不可靠。其进展严重受限于有据可依的反事实训练数据的稀缺，因为观测性视频只能捕捉实际发生的事实轨迹。自进化范式通过让模型自行构建训练问题，提供了一条超越固定数据集的途径。然而，将这一范式扩展到物理领域，需要一个外部真值来源，既能验证模型提出的环境，又能验证干预条件下替代的物理结果。我们提出了PhysEvolve，这是一个基于验证器的自进化框架，通过模型提出的可执行世界和仿真生成的任务来训练VLM进行因果物理推理。在每一轮中，一个共享的VLM提出可执行的世界程序和证据方案……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: PhysEvolve提出了一个基于验证器的自进化框架，让视觉语言模型自行生成可执行世界程序并借助仿真验证反事实物理结果，从而突破反事实训练数据稀缺的瓶颈，提升模型的因果物理推理能力。
en_tdlr: PhysEvolve is a verifier-grounded self-evolving framework that enables vision-language models to propose executable world programs and verify counterfactual physical outcomes through simulation, overcoming the scarcity of grounded counterfactual data to improve causal physical reasoning.
